edits.old: Then no code constant holds any of these values
edits.new:
Then no code constant holds any of these values

  Scenario: AC13 A retried or timed-out activity runs its effect once (activity retry and timeout)
    Given an activity of the archive export or the restore drill fails or runs past its timeout
    When the activity is retried under its retry policy
    Then the retry count and the timeout are read from configuration and no code constant holds them
    Then the retried attempt writes its row under the same idempotency key and does not run its effect twice
    Then the history records each attempt and holds no gap or duplicate event
